item.title: Hugo
item.description:
Hugo is a popular static site generator written in the Go programming language. It is a tool that builds websites from your content files defined as simple text files (usually Markdown, but also Emacs Org Mode or AsciiDoc). The you run hugo build, and it generates a folder of plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript files ready to be hosted on the internet.

Installing Hugo

In macOS, you can install Hugo using Homebrew.

item.title: Hugo: Adding Support to TeX
item.description:
The KaTeX library allow you to enable TeX support to your hugo website. The library supports all major browsers. TeX syntax allows us to write mathematical formulas and scientific symbols easily.

$$ \int_a^b f(x) dx $$

Installing

To install, we just need to import the library files from some CDN to our Hugo website. One way to do this is using the Hugo partials which allow us to import small HTML context.
